description: Ensure a default federated query routes to `web-search.learnings` and surfaces internalized findings without firing any live web request; live web joins only on explicit request or fallback escalation when project results are empty or weak.

requirements.description: Default federated queries must route exclusively to web-search.learnings (SCOPE_PROJECT) and must not issue any HTTP requests to SearXNG or external engines. The live-web provider (web-search.live) joins the federated set only when: (a) the query includes an explicit --type web or --all flag, or (b) fallback escalation is triggered because project-scoped results are empty or scored below the configured weakness threshold. Fallback escalation must be logged and the escalation reason surfaced in the result envelope.
requirements.title: Scope-Aware Federated Query Routing — Learnings-First, Live-Web Gated

validation.notes: Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings] for a default query with no flags set [the router's partitionByScope keeps SCOPE_PROJECT providers in the automatic set and withholds the SCOPE_EXTERNAL web-search.live, which is asserted absent from corpora_searched and the classifier's candidate types] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings, web-search.live] when --type web flag is present [an explicit --type web selector targets providers of type web, so corpora_searched is exactly [web-search.live]; project providers join via their own types or --all] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings, web-search.live] when --all flag is present [--all fans out to every active provider including SCOPE_EXTERNAL; sibling TestExplicitPathUnaffectedByFlag pins that the explicit path is independent of the auto-route opt-in flag] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Fallback escalation trigger fires when learnings result set is empty (zero hits) [behind the SEARCH_HUB_AUTO_ROUTE_EXTERNAL opt-in (default false; flag-off behavior pinned by TestFallbackEscalationFlagOffStaysEmpty); empty project corpus folds the withheld external provider into the fan-out via resultsWeak] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Fallback escalation trigger fires when all learnings hits score below the configured weakness threshold [IMPLEMENTED 2026-06-10: search-hub resultsWeakness extends the zero-hit trigger — behind the default-OFF SEARCH_HUB_AUTO_ROUTE_EXTERNAL flag, a round whose every non-degraded hit scores below SEARCH_HUB_AUTO_EXTERNAL_THRESHOLD (normalized 0..1, same regime as the auto-route confidence gate) folds the withheld external provider in via the same governor-protected path; the escalation reason line distinguishes 'below the weakness threshold' from 'empty' and telemetry records Escalated=true; flag-off parity pinned by TestFallbackEscalationFlagOffIgnoresWeakScores] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Escalation reason field is populated in the result envelope when fallback occurs [asserts the routing_explanation carries the 'escalated to 1 external provider(s) — project results were empty' reason line and the telemetry sample records Escalated=true] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

A default federated query against a populated learnings store issues exactly zero HTTP calls to SearXNG (HTTP mock asserts zero external calls) [the mock transport has NO canned response for the web-search.live endpoint, so any HTTP call to it would surface as a degraded group in corpora_searched; the test asserts web-search.live is absent while the project provider answers] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

A default federated query against an empty learnings store triggers fallback escalation and subsequently queries SearXNG (HTTP mock asserts exactly one SearXNG call with escalation reason in response) [the project provider returns zero hits over the HTTP mock, the router escalates once to web-search.live's mocked LiveSearchService endpoint (which fronts SearXNG), and the escalation reason is asserted in routing_explanation + telemetry; graceful degrade on a rate-limited live call is pinned by sibling TestEscalationDegradesGracefullyOnGovernorReject] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Default federated query served entirely from learnings completes with zero external HTTP calls and within 500ms at p95 [the zero-external-calls half is covered by ../search-hub/api/internal/routing/router_test.go::TestAutoRouteWithholdsExternalScope; the p95 latency half requires the live federated stack (search-hub + web-search + qdrant/ollama up) so it is an ATTENDED live validation: the monthly runbook scripts/live-validate.sh times a default learnings query against the populated store (warm SearchFindings measured 42ms, so 500ms is realistic), asserts zero LiveSearchService calls via log delta, and logs evidence via `test-genie requirements manual-log --expires-in 30` (30-day TTL, honest regression on lapse)]

Standard developer queries against internalized research findings do not consume any live-web rate-limit budget [with the default flag-off configuration even a confidently web-shaped query never auto-reaches web-search.live, so no default query can spend SearXNG budget; the plain default path is additionally pinned by TestAutoRouteWithholdsExternalScope] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]

Fallback escalation to live web is observable in logs and result metadata for audit purposes [escalation is asserted observable in two audit surfaces: the response's routing_explanation ('escalated to 1 external provider(s)...') and the recorded telemetry sample (Escalated=true, AutoRoutedExternal=false)] [covering test lives in search-hub — scope-aware routing is the router's half of the contract]
